intro: 12 個財務報表情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: We desire to have our own home.
ex.zh: 我們渴望擁有自己的房子。

ex.en: He desires to retire when he becomes forty.
ex.zh: 他希望四十歲就退休。

note: desire to V 渴望做某事
desirable 令人嚮往的;desired 想要的

ex.en: The business planner detailed the steps we should follow to write our financial statement.
ex.zh: 商業規劃師詳細說明了我們撰寫財務報表應遵循的步驟。

ex.en: Fabio created a financial statement that detailed every expected expenditure for the next quarter.
ex.zh: 法比歐製作了一份財務報表,詳列下一季每一筆預期支出。

note: 名詞為「細節」;in detail 詳細地

ex.en: The financial forecast indicates a deficit in the next quarter.
ex.zh: 財務預測顯示下一季將出現赤字。

ex.en: Analysts forecast a strong economic outlook.
ex.zh: 分析師預測經濟前景強勁。

note: 過去式可用 forecast 或 forecasted
weather forecast 天氣預報;sales forecast 銷售預測

ex.en: We have never had an accountant work at such a sophisticated level before.
ex.zh: 我們以前從沒請過水準這麼高的會計師。

ex.en: If you expect your business to earn at higher levels, your financial statement should show that.
ex.zh: 如果你預期你的事業獲利會更高,財務報表就應該呈現出來。

note: at a high level 在高水準;level of income 收入水準

ex.en: The company's overall expectations were out of proportion.
ex.zh: 這家公司的整體期望太不切實際了。

ex.en: Our overall financial situation is not too bad.
ex.zh: 我們整體的財務狀況還不算太糟。

note: 也可作副詞「整體而言」,如 Overall, it went well.
out of proportion 不成比例、過度

ex.en: The budget statement gave us perspective on where the costs of running the business are found.
ex.zh: 預算表讓我們看清經營這門生意的成本出在哪裡。

ex.en: Joseph's accountant gave him some perspective as well as some data on how much he could expect to earn in his first year in business.
ex.zh: 約瑟夫的會計師給了他一些看法,也提供了一些數據,說明他創業第一年預計能賺多少。

note: put sth in perspective 正確看待某事;from my perspective 從我的觀點

ex.en: We need to project our earnings and expenses in order to plan next year's budget.
ex.zh: 我們需要預估收入與支出,才能規劃明年的預算。

ex.en: The director projects that the company will need to hire ten new employees this year.
ex.zh: 主管預估公司今年需要雇用十名新員工。

note: 動詞重音在後 pro-JECT;名詞「專案」重音在前 PRO-ject

ex.en: An accurate accounting gave Stefano a realistic idea of his business's financial direction.
ex.zh: 準確的帳目讓史蒂法諾對自己事業的財務走向有了實際的認識。

ex.en: Realistic expectations are important when you review your financial statements.
ex.zh: 檢視財務報表時,抱持實際的期望很重要。

ex.en: We targeted March as the deadline for completing the financial statement.
ex.zh: 我們把三月訂為完成財務報表的期限。

ex.en: Matilde hoped to sign on five new clients last month, but she didn't reach her target.
ex.zh: 瑪蒂妲原本希望上個月簽下五位新客戶,但她沒有達成目標。

note: reach / meet a target 達成目標;target market 目標市場
targeted 不重複子音(重音在前)

ex.en: The translation of the statement from Japanese into English was very helpful.
ex.zh: 把報表從日文譯成英文非常有幫助。

ex.en: The accountant provided a translation of the financial terms in a language we could all understand.
ex.zh: 會計師把財務術語翻譯成我們都聽得懂的語言。

note: translate A into B 把 A 翻成 B

ex.en: Office expenses typically include such things as salaries, rent, and office supplies.
ex.zh: 辦公室開支通常包括薪資、租金和辦公用品等項目。

ex.en: Banks typically require a financial statement before they will lend money to a small business.
ex.zh: 銀行通常會先要求財務報表,才肯借錢給小型企業。

ex.en: Henry's budget gave him the desired yield: a better indication of his expected profit.
ex.zh: 亨利的預算帶給他想要的成果:更清楚地掌握預期利潤。

ex.en: The company's investment yielded high returns.
ex.zh: 這家公司的投資帶來了高報酬。

note: 另有「讓步、屈服」之意;路標 YIELD 為「讓行」
yield a profit / return 產生利潤、報酬
